name: command-room
description: Claude as your chief of staff. Turns a folder of notes, transcripts, and emails into an executive workspace. The Hub: one private page that preps your next meetings, drafts your inbox and shows your plate. Morning Brief each weekday, and a silent Maintenance task that keeps the workspace tidy. Writing: emails, memos, one-pagers, board updates — voice-calibrated to you. Memory layer: decision log, people, pipeline and insights.
